_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Long-Range Plan for Maintenance, Modification, and Support
summary: The Long-Range Plan (LRP) documents and tracks the planned incorporation of future maintenance actions, modifications, and subsystem overhauls to C-40A aircraft ahead of the need to program funding and generate Technical Directives for implementation.
use_relationship:
The Long-Range Plan for Maintenance, Modification, and Support (hereafter called the Long Range Plan (LRP)) documents and tracks the planned incorporation of future maintenance actions, modifications, and subsystem overhauls to C-40A aircraft ahead of the need to program funding and generate Technical Directives for implementation.  The LRP provides a means to maintain long-term visibility of required and desired maintenance actions, modifications, and overhauls (as applicable) to the aircraft, major aircraft subsystems, and components.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

children.title: Title Page
children.content: The LRP shall contain a title page identifying the following:

children.title: Signature block(s) showing corporate release approval
Table of Contents
children.content: The LRP shall contain a table of contents of the major sections as defined in Section 5.

children.title: Contents
children.content: The LRP shall contain the following information to support the forecasting, coordination, and integration of long-range maintenance actions and modifications into future fleet operations:

children.title: Overview
children.content: Description of the use and function of the Plan; integration of the Plan with the Service Action Review Board (SARB); integration of the Plan with the schedule for defined depot activities and major subsystem overhauls; and definition of roles, responsibilities, and interactions among entities involved with support planning for the aircraft.

children.title: Current Fleet Configuration
children.content: Listing that correlates aircraft tail number with the serial numbers of currently installed landing gear assemblies, engines, auxiliary power unit (APU), and forward and rear air stair assemblies.

children.title: Mandated Modifications
children.content: Listing that correlates Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) mandated modifications (e.g., Airworthiness Directives) for the aircraft, landing gear assemblies, engines, and APU with aircraft tail number or serial number for major subsystem components.

children.title: Planned Depot Maintenance Activities
children.content: Listing of ADs; Service Actions (SAs); aircraft weight and balance; aircraft painting; and overhauls of landing gear assemblies, engines, APU, and forward and rear air stair assemblies.  The listing shall be arranged by aircraft tail number and depot (C Check) date for a minimum of 12 years (four C Checks) into the future following each LRP update.

children.title: Engines
children.content: Section containing an engine overhaul schedule as well as a listing of incorporation requirements by calendar year for applicable ADs and SAs.  This section of the plan also should contain a complete history on the movement of engines within the fleet.

children.title: APUs
children.content: Section containing an APU overhaul schedule as well as a listing of incorporation requirements by calendar year for applicable ADs and SAs.  This section of the plan also should contain a complete history on the movement of APUs within the fleet.

children.title: Landing Gear (LG) Assemblies
children.content: Section containing an overhaul schedule for left-hand main LG, right-hand main LG, and nose LG assemblies as well as a listing of incorporation requirements by calendar year for applicable ADs and SAs.  This section of the plan also should contain a complete history on the movement of landing gear within the fleet.

children.title: Forward and Rear Air Stair Assemblies
children.content: Section containing an overhaul schedule for the forward and rear air stair assemblies as well as a listing of incorporation requirements by calendar year for applicable ADs and SAs.  This section of the plan also should contain a complete history on the movement of the forward and rear air stairs within the fleet.

children.title: Cross Reference Listing
children.content: Section containing a listing referenced to ADs and SAs applicable to the aircraft, landing gear assemblies, engines, APU, and forward and rear air stairs.  The listing shall relate each AD and SA to the effectivity of the aircraft or major subsystem component; the current status of AD/SA incorporation on each aircraft or major subsystem component; and the planned dates of AD/SA incorporation on each aircraft or major subsystem component.

children.title: Media Requirements
children.content: The report shall be provided as a searchable Adobe Portable Document File (PDF).
